name: Magical Tinkering
description: With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, touch a Tiny object that isn't magical and give it one property you pick:

Light: bright light 5 ft out and dim light 5 ft beyond that. Message: a recording of up to 6 seconds, spoken as you set it, that plays for anyone within 10 ft when a creature taps the object. Smell or sound: a steady odor or wordless noise (wind, waves, chirps) noticeable 10 ft away. Image: a still picture, text of up to 25 words, lines and shapes, or any mix of them, on one of its surfaces.
It lasts with no time limit; touch the object as an action to end it sooner.
Each object holds one property. You keep at most your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) of them going; a new one past that cap ends the oldest first.

name: Flash of Genius
trigger: You, or a creature in sight within 30 ft, rolls an ability check or saving throw
description: Add your Intelligence modifier to that roll.

name: Spell-Storing Item
uses: Twice your Intelligence modifier (minimum 2) per stored spell; store one on each long rest
description: As a long rest ends, touch a simple or martial weapon, or an item you could use as a spellcasting focus, and store an artificer spell in it. The spell is 1st or 2nd level with a casting time of 1 action, and you need not have it prepared.
Action (by whoever holds it): release the spell's effect from the item, using your spellcasting ability modifier. A spell that needs concentration has the holder concentrate.
The spell stays until used twice your Intelligence modifier times (at least twice), or until you store a spell again.

name: Soul of Artifice
trigger: You drop to 0 hit points and aren't killed outright
description: End one of your artificer infusions; you fall to 1 hit point rather than 0.
Always on: +1 to every saving throw for each magic item you are attuned to.

name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
description: The wearer gains 5 ft of walking speed.

Each gauntlet of the armor is a magic melee weapon, usable only while that hand is empty, and the wearer is proficient with it. A hit deals 1d8 force damage. It can be thrown (range 20/60 ft): it flies off at the target, then comes straight back and reattaches.
The armor can't be taken off the wearer against its will, and it stands in for any missing limbs, working just like them.

name: Armor of Magical Strength
trigger: The wearer rolls a Strength check, or a save using Strength
description: Spend 1 charge to add the wearer's Intelligence modifier to that roll.
Reaction, when the wearer would be knocked prone: spend 1 charge to stay on its feet.

name: Boots of the Winding Path
description: The wearer teleports as far as 15 ft into an empty space it can see. It must have been in that space at some point this turn.

name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
description: Whoever holds it adds +1 to spell attack rolls (+2 once you are an artificer of level 10), and the holder's spell attacks ignore half cover.

name: Enhanced Defense

prereq.text: Suit of armor or a shield

description: Wearing the armor, or wielding the shield, gives +1 AC (+2 once you are an artificer of level 10).

name: Enhanced Weapon
description: It becomes a magic weapon with +1 to attack and damage rolls (+2 once you are an artificer of level 10).

name: Helm of Awareness
description: The wearer rolls initiative with advantage, and can't be surprised unless it is incapacitated.

name: Homunculus Servant

prereq.text: Gem or crystal worth 100 gp or more

description: The infused gem becomes the heart of a Tiny construct that forms around it at once, looking however you like. It is friendly to you and your companions, obeys you, and its stats use your proficiency bonus.

It shares your initiative and acts right after you. It moves and reacts by itself, but its only action is Dodge unless you spend a bonus action to command it (Force Strike or any other action). While you are incapacitated it acts as it likes.

Force Strike: a ranged attack with your spell attack modifier, 30 ft, 1d4 + your proficiency bonus force damage. Reaction (Channel Magic): it delivers a touch-range spell you cast, if it is no more than 120 ft from you.
Casting mending on it restores 2d6 hit points. If it or you die, it vanishes and leaves the heart behind.
Stat block: Tasha's p. 22.

name: Mind Sharpener
trigger: The wearer fails a Constitution save to keep concentrating on a spell
description: Spend 1 charge: a jolt from the item refocuses the wearer, and the failed save becomes a success.

name: Radiant Weapon
description: Spend 1 charge: the attacker is blinded until its next turn ends, unless it passes a Constitution save against your spell save DC.
Always on: it is a magic weapon with +1 to attack and damage rolls. Bonus action: make it shine (bright light 30 ft, dim light 30 ft more), or put the light out.

name: Repeating Shot

prereq.text: Ranged weapon with ammunition, simple or martial (attunement)

description: It becomes a magic weapon with +1 to attack and damage rolls on ranged attacks, and loading doesn't apply to it.
With no ammunition loaded, it makes a magic piece of its own for each ranged attack; the piece vanishes right after it hits or misses.

name: Replicate Magic Item

prereq.text: Whatever object the chosen item needs

description: Pick one magic item this infusion lets you make. You can learn it more than once, choosing another item each time. Items come from the lists below, up to your artificer level, or you can take any common magic item other than a potion or scroll.
The Dungeon Master's Guide entry says what object each item needs and whether it requires attunement.
Level 2: Alchemy jug, Bag of holding, Cap of water breathing, Goggles of night, Rope of climbing, Sending stones, Wand of magic detection, Wand of secrets.
Level 6: Boots of elvenkind, Cloak of elvenkind, Cloak of the manta ray, Eyes of charming, Gloves of thievery, Lantern of revealing, Pipes of haunting, Ring of water walking.

Level 10: Boots of striding and springing, Boots of the winterlands, Bracers of archery, Brooch of shielding, Cloak of protection, Eyes of the eagle, Gauntlets of ogre power, Gloves of missile snaring, Gloves of swimming and climbing, Hat of disguise, Headband of intellect, Helm of telepathy, Medallion of thoughts, Necklace of adaptation, Periapt of wound closure, Pipes of the sewers, Quiver of Ehlonna, Ring of jumping, Ring of mind shielding, Slippers of spider climbing, Winged boots.

Level 14: Amulet of health, Belt of hill giant strength, Boots of levitation, Boots of speed, Bracers of defense, Cloak of the bat, Dimensional shackles, Gem of seeing, Horn of blasting, Ring of free action, Ring of protection, Ring of the ram.

name: Repulsion Shield
trigger: A melee attack hits the wielder
description: Spend 1 charge to shove the attacker as far as 15 ft away.
Always on: +1 AC while the shield is wielded.

name: Resistant Armor
description: The wearer resists one damage type, picked when you infuse the armor: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, force, necrotic, poison, psychic or radiant.

name: Returning Weapon
description: It becomes a magic weapon with +1 to attack and damage rolls, and it flies back to the wielder's hand right after each ranged attack made with it.

name: Spell-Refueling Ring
description: The wearer gets back one spent spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

name: Experimental Elixir
description: As each long rest ends, you can make the free elixirs shown below, each in its own empty flask you touch. Roll a d6 per elixir for its effect.
Action: brew one more in an empty flask by spending any spell slot (1st level or above). You choose its effect rather than rolling.
You need alchemist's supplies on you to make one. Drinking an elixir, or feeding it to an incapacitated creature, takes an action. Unused, it spoils when your next long rest ends.
1 Healing: the drinker heals 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier.
2 Swiftness: walking speed +10 ft, 1 hour.
3 Resilience: +1 AC, 10 minutes.
4 Boldness: 1 minute of adding a d4 to each attack roll and save.
5 Flight: fly speed 10 ft, 10 minutes.
6 Transformation: alter self (the drinker picks the change), 10 minutes.

name: Alchemical Savant
trigger: You cast a spell with alchemist's supplies as your focus
description: Add your Intelligence modifier (at least +1) to one roll of that spell: a roll that heals, or a damage roll for acid, fire, necrotic or poison damage.

name: Restorative Reagents

spells.uses: Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per long rest, no slot

description: Cast lesser restoration with no spell slot, even if you haven't prepared it, using alchemist's supplies as your focus.
Always on: whoever drinks one of your experimental elixirs also gains 2d6 + your Intelligence modifier temporary hit points (at least 1).

name: Chemical Mastery
uses: Each spell once per long rest

spells.uses: Once per long rest, no slot
Once per long rest, no slot

description: Cast greater restoration or heal with no spell slot, no preparation and no material components, using alchemist's supplies as your focus.
Always on: you resist acid and poison damage and are immune to the poisoned condition.

name: Arcane Armor
description: With smith's tools in hand, turn a suit of armor you have on into Arcane Armor.

While you wear it, it has no Strength requirement for you, it is a focus for your artificer spells, nobody can take it off you against your will, and it covers your whole body, standing in for any missing limbs.
Bonus action: retract or deploy the helmet. Action: don or doff the armor.
It keeps this state until you put on different armor, or until you die. Pick its model (Guardian or Infiltrator) with Armor Model.

name: Thunder Gauntlets
description: Attack (as part of the Attack action) with a gauntlet, a simple melee weapon while that hand is empty: 1d8 thunder damage on a hit. Use your Intelligence modifier for its attack and damage rolls.
A creature you hit has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you until your next turn starts.

name: Defensive Field
description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your artificer level. They replace any you already have, and you lose them if you take the armor off.

name: Perfected Armor (Guardian)
trigger: A creature you can see, of size Huge or smaller, finishes its turn no more than 30 ft away
description: It makes a Strength save against your spell save DC. On a failure you pull it as far as 30 ft toward you, into an empty space.
If that leaves it within 5 ft of you, you may also attack it once with a melee weapon, still within this reaction.

name: Lightning Launcher
description: Attack (as part of the Attack action) with the gemlike node on a gauntlet or your chest, a simple ranged weapon: range 90/300 ft, 1d6 lightning damage on a hit. Use your Intelligence modifier for its attack and damage rolls.
Once on each of your turns, when it hits a creature, add 1d6 lightning damage.

name: Perfected Armor (Infiltrator)
trigger: Your Lightning Launcher deals lightning damage to a creature
description: Until your next turn starts, it sheds a faint glow (dim light, radius 5 ft), and its attacks against you have disadvantage.
The next attack roll on it gains advantage; on a hit, that attack also deals 1d6 extra lightning damage.

name: Guardian
description: A front-line build: your Arcane Armor gets Thunder Gauntlets and Defensive Field (and Perfected Armor at 15).
You can switch models when you finish a short or long rest, with smith's tools in hand.

name: Infiltrator
description: A stealth build: your Arcane Armor gets Lightning Launcher (and Perfected Armor at 15).
Always on while you wear it: +5 ft walking speed, and Stealth checks have advantage (any disadvantage the armor imposes on them cancels it).
You can switch models when you finish a short or long rest, with smith's tools in hand.

name: Eldritch Cannon
uses: Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot of any level
description: Action: with woodcarver's or smith's tools, conjure a Small or Tiny cannon in an empty spot on flat ground no more than 5 ft away. A Small one fills its space; a Tiny one fits in one hand. Pick its looks, whether it has legs, and its type.
You can't build another while it is still around. Activate it with a bonus action while you are within 60 ft (see Eldritch Cannon: Activate).

The cannon is a magical object: AC 18, hit points 5 × your artificer level, immune to poison and psychic damage, and it rolls checks and saves as if every ability score were 10 (+0). Mending heals it 2d6.
It lasts 1 hour, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you take an action to dismiss it.
Flamethrower: a cone of fire that forces a Dexterity save.
Force Ballista: a ranged spell attack that deals force damage and shoves.
Protector: temporary hit points for itself and creatures you pick near it.

name: Eldritch Cannon: Activate
description: Bonus action, while you are within 60 ft of your cannon: it does what its type does. As part of the same bonus action, a cannon with legs can walk or climb up to 15 ft into an empty space.

Flamethrower: fire fills a 15-ft cone next to the cannon, pointed where you choose. Each creature inside makes a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking the fire damage below on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects nobody is wearing or carrying catch fire.

Force Ballista: the cannon makes a ranged spell attack against one creature or object up to 120 ft away. A hit deals the force damage below, and a creature it hits is shoved up to 5 ft away from the cannon.
Protector: the cannon and any creatures you pick within 10 ft of it gain 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier temporary hit points (at least 1).
15th level (Fortified Position): you can keep two cannons at once, made with one action but not with one spell slot, and one bonus action activates both.

name: Arcane Firearm
trigger: You cast an artificer spell through your arcane firearm
description: Roll a d8 and add it to one damage roll of that spell.

Setup: as a long rest ends, use woodcarver's tools to carve sigils into a wand, staff or rod; it becomes your arcane firearm and a focus for your artificer spells. The sigils last until you carve them into some other item.

name: Explosive Cannon
description: Action, while you are within 60 ft of your cannon: blow it up. The cannon is destroyed, and each creature within 20 ft of it makes a Dexterity save against your spell save DC: 3d8 force damage if it fails, half as much if it succeeds.
Always on: each damage roll your cannons make gains an extra 1d8 (already counted on Eldritch Cannon: Activate).

name: Steel Defender
description: You have a steel defender, a Medium construct that is friendly to you and your companions, obeys you, and uses your proficiency bonus in its stats. Pick its looks and whether it walks on two legs or four (no effect on its stats).

It shares your initiative and acts right after you. It moves and reacts by itself, but its only action is Dodge unless you spend a bonus action to command it (Force-Empowered Rend, Repair or any other action). While you are incapacitated it acts as it likes.

Force-Empowered Rend: a melee attack with your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft, 1d8 + your proficiency bonus force damage. Repair (3 per day): 2d8 + your proficiency bonus hit points to itself or a construct or object within 5 ft. Reaction (Deflect Attack): an attack roll by a creature it can see within 5 ft, made against anyone else, has disadvantage.

Casting mending on it restores 2d6 hit points. Action (revive): if it died no more than 1 hour ago, use smith's tools within 5 ft of it and spend any spell slot (1st level or above); a minute later it is back, at full hit points.
As a long rest ends you can build a new one, if you have smith's tools; any earlier one perishes at once. It also perishes if you die.
15th level (Improved Defender): it gets +2 AC, and each Deflect Attack also deals 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier force damage to the attacker.
Stat block: Tasha's p. 19.

name: Arcane Jolt
trigger: An attack you make with a magic weapon hits, or so does an attack by your steel defender
description: Pick one: the target takes the extra force damage below, or you heal that many hit points to a creature or object in your sight, no more than 30 ft from the target.
No more than once per turn.
